title: Role-based access control (RBAC) in CloudDash
content:
## Roles overview

CloudDash uses four built-in roles. Roles are assigned per organization and apply across all workspaces.

| Role | Who should have it | Key permissions |
|------|-------------------|------------------|
| **Owner** | Founder/primary admin | Everything including billing, delete org, transfer ownership |
| **Admin** | IT admins, team leads | Manage members, integrations, all dashboards/alerts. No billing access. |
| **Member** | Engineers, DevOps | View and edit dashboards, alerts, and integrations they are assigned to |
| **Viewer** | Stakeholders, read-only users | View dashboards and alert history only. No edits. |

## Changing a user's role
1. Go to **Settings → Team Management**.
2. Find the user and click **Edit**.
3. Select the new role from the dropdown.
4. Click **Save**.

## Dashboard-level permissions
In addition to org-level roles, individual dashboards can be shared with:
- **Specific users** — override org role for that dashboard
- **Teams** — all members of a team get the specified access level
- **Anyone with link** — view-only for anyone who has the share URL

## Enterprise: custom roles (coming Q3 2026)
Enterprise customers will be able to define custom roles with granular permission sets.

## Audit trail
All role changes are logged in **Settings → Audit Logs** with timestamp, actor, and previous/new role.
